scripts._comment: BullMQ workers + scheduler + work listener run inside the @rinjani/api process; the BullMQ scheduler is the single source of truth for feed-sync dispatch. This package only ships one-off CLI helpers (sync, sync:feeds, sync:alienvault, ...) and the legacy standalone setInterval daemon (sync:daemon / dev:standalone / start:standalone), which is no longer deployed by default — kept as an emergency manual fallback if BullMQ ever needs to be bypassed.
